studies.Study: van de Pol JAA et al. (2021) [PMID: 32638386]
studies.Population: Netherlands Cohort Study (NLCS) participants aged 55-69 years at baseline
studies.Ethnicity Basis: Population imputation: stated White/European population -> White
studies.Ethnicity Supporting Text: The NLCS is a nation‐wide prospective cohort study initiated in September 1986 with the inclusion of 58 279 men and 62 573 women between the ages of 55 and 69 years.
studies.Reference: Etiologic heterogeneity of clear-cell and papillary renal cell carcinoma in the Netherlands Cohort Study.
studies.Authors: van de Pol JAA, George L, van den Brandt PA, Baldewijns MMLL, Schouten LJ
studies.exposure_measurement_supporting_text: Questions on beer, red wine, white wine, sherry, fortified wines, liqueur and liquor were used to assess the consumption of alcohol.

sample_size.excerpt: In 1986, 120 852 participants aged 55 to 69 completed a self‐administered questionnaire on diet and other risk factors for cancer. Participants were followed up for cancer through record linkage.

cases.excerpt: Of the 384 included RCC cases with confirmed tumor histology 315 (82.0%) were ccRCC cases and 46 (12.0%) were pRCC cases.

design.excerpt: The NLCS is a nation‐wide prospective cohort study initiated in September 1986 with the inclusion of 58 279 men and 62 573 women between the ages of 55 and 69 years.
